rationale: Coefficient passed to switch_load_balancing_loss_func must equal config.moe_aux_loss_coeff / tp_world_size; otherwise aux-loss grad inflates by tp_size after TP all-reduce. Topology-aware (depends on TP size) and precond-gated (only when MoE aux loss enabled). Borderline moe vs loss_computation: chose loss_computation because root cause is missing TP scaling, parallel to numerical loss-scaling bugs. P4 because check reads function arg at hook point.
